question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are playing a game. At the start of the game, they are each holding a ball: Alice has a blue ball, Bob has a black ball, Claire has a purple ball, Dave has a green ball, Eve has a yellow ball, Fred has a white ball, and Gertrude has a brown ball.
As the game progresses, pairs of players trade balls. First, Eve and Fred swap balls. Then, Dave and Bob swap balls. Then, Fred and Alice swap balls. Then, Alice and Bob swap balls. Then, Alice and Eve swap balls. Then, Bob and Fred swap balls. Finally, Dave and Alice swap balls. At the end of the game, Gertrude has the
Options:
(A) blue ball
(B) black ball
(C) purple ball
(D) green ball
(E) yellow ball
(F) white ball
(G) brown ball
solution:
Ball colors are listed in this order: Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude.
Initial: blue, black, purple, green, yellow, white, brown.
1. Eve ↔ Fred: blue, black, purple, green, white, yellow, brown.
2. Dave ↔ Bob: blue, green, purple, black, white, yellow, brown.
3. Fred ↔ Alice: yellow, green, purple, black, white, blue, brown.
4. Alice ↔ Bob: green, yellow, purple, black, white, blue, brown.
5. Alice ↔ Eve: white, yellow, purple, black, green, blue, brown.
6. Bob ↔ Fred: white, blue, purple, black, green, yellow, brown.
7. Dave ↔ Alice: black, blue, purple, white, green, yellow, brown.
Gertrude has the brown ball, option (G).
Final answer: (G)
